SELECT EMP_NO AS EMP_NO, SALES_AREA FROM TB_CM06M01 WHERE EMP_NO IN
#{item, jdbcType=VARCHAR}

SELECT WORK_DT, SUM(CASE WHEN IN_TM IS NOT NULL OR OUT_TM IS NOT NULL OR IN_DTTM IS NOT NULL OR OUT_DTTM IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS WORKER_CNT, SUM(CASE WHEN (IN_TM IS NOT NULL OR OUT_TM IS NOT NULL OR IN_DTTM IS NOT NULL OR OUT_DTTM IS NOT NULL) AND NVL(HOLIDAY_YN,'평일') = '평일' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS NORMAL_CNT, SUM(CASE WHEN (IN_TM IS NOT NULL OR OUT_TM IS NOT NULL OR IN_DTTM IS NOT NULL OR OUT_DTTM IS NOT NULL) AND LATE_TXT IS NOT NULL AND LATE_TXT != '' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS LATE_CNT, SUM(CASE WHEN (IN_TM IS NOT NULL OR OUT_TM IS NOT NULL OR IN_DTTM IS NOT NULL OR OUT_DTTM IS NOT NULL) AND EARLY_LEAVE_TXT IS NOT NULL AND EARLY_LEAVE_TXT != '' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS EARLY_CNT, SUM(CASE WHEN (IN_TM IS NULL OR IN_TM = '') AND (OUT_TM IS NULL OR OUT_TM = '') AND (IN_DTTM IS NULL OR IN_DTTM = '') AND (OUT_DTTM IS NULL OR OUT_DTTM = '') AND NVL(HOLIDAY_YN,'평일') = '평일' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS ABSENCE_CNT, SUM(CASE WHEN (IN_TM IS NOT NULL OR OUT_TM IS NOT NULL OR IN_DTTM IS NOT NULL OR OUT_DTTM IS NOT NULL) AND NVL(HOLIDAY_YN,'평일') = '휴일' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS HOLIDAY_CNT, SUM(CASE WHEN (IN_TM IS NOT NULL OR OUT_TM IS NOT NULL OR IN_DTTM IS NOT NULL OR OUT_DTTM IS NOT NULL) AND U.SALES_AREA = 'SALESAREA60' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS HOURLY_CNT, SUM(CASE WHEN (IN_TM IS NOT NULL OR OUT_TM IS NOT NULL OR IN_DTTM IS NOT NULL OR OUT_DTTM IS NOT NULL) AND NVL(U.SALES_AREA, ' ') != 'SALESAREA60' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS SALARY_CNT, SUM(NVL(TO_NUMBER(NULLIF(REPLACE(TOT_WORK_TM, ':', '.'), '')), 0)) AS TOTAL_WORK_TM, SUM(NVL(TO_NUMBER(NULLIF(REPLACE(OT_TM, ':', '.'), '')), 0)) AS OT_TM, SUM(NVL(TO_NUMBER(NULLIF(REPLACE(NGHT_TM, ':', '.'), '')), 0)) AS NGHT_TM, SUM(CASE WHEN TRIP_APPL_NO IS NOT NULL OR TRIP_REPLY_NO IS NOT NULL OR TRIP_WORK_PLACE IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS TRIP_CNT, MAX(RMK) AS RMK FROM TB_PM30M01 A LEFT JOIN TB_CM06M01 U ON U.EMP_NO = A.EMP_NO WHERE A.CO_CD = #{coCd, jdbcType=VARCHAR} AND A.WORK_DT BETWEEN #{stDt, jdbcType=VARCHAR} AND #{edDt, jdbcType=VARCHAR}
AND (A.EMP_NO LIKE '%' || #{workerKeyword, jdbcType=VARCHAR} || '%' OR A.EMP_NM LIKE '%' || #{workerKeyword, jdbcType=VARCHAR} || '%')
AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM TB_CM06M01 D WHERE D.EMP_NO = A.EMP_NO AND SUBSTR(D.DEPT_ID, 1, 5) = SUBSTR(#{deptId, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, 1, 5))
AND (A.TRIP_APPL_NO IS NOT NULL OR A.TRIP_REPLY_NO IS NOT NULL OR A.TRIP_WORK_PLACE IS NOT NULL)
AND A.VAC_APPL_NO IS NOT NULL
GROUP BY WORK_DT ORDER BY WORK_DT

SELECT A.EMP_NO, A.EMP_NM, CASE WHEN U.SALES_AREA = 'SALESAREA60' THEN '시급직' ELSE '연봉직' END AS WORKER_TYPE, SUM(CASE WHEN A.IN_TM IS NOT NULL OR A.OUT_TM IS NOT NULL OR A.IN_DTTM IS NOT NULL OR A.OUT_DTTM IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS WORK_DAY_CNT, SUM(CASE WHEN (A.IN_TM IS NOT NULL OR A.OUT_TM IS NOT NULL OR A.IN_DTTM IS NOT NULL OR A.OUT_DTTM IS NOT NULL) AND A.LATE_TXT IS NOT NULL AND A.LATE_TXT != '' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS LATE_CNT, SUM(CASE WHEN (A.IN_TM IS NOT NULL OR A.OUT_TM IS NOT NULL OR A.IN_DTTM IS NOT NULL OR A.OUT_DTTM IS NOT NULL) AND A.EARLY_LEAVE_TXT IS NOT NULL AND A.EARLY_LEAVE_TXT != '' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS EARLY_CNT, SUM(CASE WHEN (A.IN_TM IS NULL OR A.IN_TM = '') AND (A.OUT_TM IS NULL OR A.OUT_TM = '') AND (A.IN_DTTM IS NULL OR A.IN_DTTM = '') AND (A.OUT_DTTM IS NULL OR A.OUT_DTTM = '') AND NVL(A.HOLIDAY_YN,'평일') = '평일' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS ABSENCE_CNT, SUM(CASE WHEN (A.IN_TM IS NOT NULL OR A.OUT_TM IS NOT NULL OR A.IN_DTTM IS NOT NULL OR A.OUT_DTTM IS NOT NULL) AND NVL(A.HOLIDAY_YN,'평일') = '휴일' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS HOLIDAY_CNT, SUM(CASE WHEN (A.IN_TM IS NOT NULL OR A.OUT_TM IS NOT NULL OR A.IN_DTTM IS NOT NULL OR A.OUT_DTTM IS NOT NULL) AND NVL(A.HOLIDAY_YN,'평일') = '평일' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS NORMAL_DAY_CNT, SUM(NVL(TO_NUMBER(NULLIF(REPLACE(A.TOT_WORK_TM, ':', '.'), '')), 0)) AS TOTAL_WORK_TM, SUM(NVL(TO_NUMBER(NULLIF(REPLACE(A.OT_TM, ':', '.'), '')), 0)) AS OT_TM, SUM(NVL(TO_NUMBER(NULLIF(REPLACE(A.NGHT_TM, ':', '.'), '')), 0)) AS NGHT_TM FROM TB_PM30M01 A LEFT JOIN TB_CM06M01 U ON U.EMP_NO = A.EMP_NO WHERE A.CO_CD = #{coCd, jdbcType=VARCHAR} AND A.WORK_DT BETWEEN #{stDt, jdbcType=VARCHAR} AND #{edDt, jdbcType=VARCHAR}
AND (A.EMP_NO LIKE '%' || #{workerKeyword, jdbcType=VARCHAR} || '%' OR A.EMP_NM LIKE '%' || #{workerKeyword, jdbcType=VARCHAR} || '%')
AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM TB_CM06M01 D WHERE D.EMP_NO = A.EMP_NO AND SUBSTR(D.DEPT_ID, 1, 5) = SUBSTR(#{deptId, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, 1, 5))
AND (A.TRIP_APPL_NO IS NOT NULL OR A.TRIP_REPLY_NO IS NOT NULL OR A.TRIP_WORK_PLACE IS NOT NULL)
AND A.VAC_APPL_NO IS NOT NULL
GROUP BY A.EMP_NO, A.EMP_NM, U.SALES_AREA ORDER BY A.EMP_NM, A.EMP_NO

SELECT A.EMP_NO, A.EMP_NM, SUM(CASE WHEN A.IN_TM IS NOT NULL OR A.OUT_TM IS NOT NULL OR A.IN_DTTM IS NOT NULL OR A.OUT_DTTM IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS WORK_DAY_CNT, SUM(CASE WHEN (A.IN_TM IS NOT NULL OR A.OUT_TM IS NOT NULL OR A.IN_DTTM IS NOT NULL OR A.OUT_DTTM IS NOT NULL) AND A.LATE_TXT IS NOT NULL AND A.LATE_TXT != '' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS LATE_CNT, SUM(CASE WHEN (A.IN_TM IS NOT NULL OR A.OUT_TM IS NOT NULL OR A.IN_DTTM IS NOT NULL OR A.OUT_DTTM IS NOT NULL) AND A.EARLY_LEAVE_TXT IS NOT NULL AND A.EARLY_LEAVE_TXT != '' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS EARLY_CNT, SUM(CASE WHEN (A.IN_DTTM IS NULL OR A.IN_DTTM = '') AND (A.OUT_DTTM IS NULL OR A.OUT_DTTM = '') AND (A.IN_TM IS NULL OR A.IN_TM = '') AND (A.OUT_TM IS NULL OR A.OUT_TM = '') AND NVL(A.HOLIDAY_YN,'평일') = '평일' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS ABSENCE_CNT, SUM(CASE WHEN (A.IN_TM IS NOT NULL OR A.OUT_TM IS NOT NULL OR A.IN_DTTM IS NOT NULL OR A.OUT_DTTM IS NOT NULL) AND NVL(A.HOLIDAY_YN,'평일') = '평일' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS NORMAL_DAY_CNT, SUM(CASE WHEN (A.IN_TM IS NOT NULL OR A.OUT_TM IS NOT NULL OR A.IN_DTTM IS NOT NULL OR A.OUT_DTTM IS NOT NULL) AND NVL(A.HOLIDAY_YN,'평일') = '휴일' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS HOLIDAY_DAY_CNT, SUM(NVL(TO_NUMBER(NULLIF(REPLACE(A.TOT_WORK_TM, ':', '.'), '')), 0)) AS TOTAL_WORK_TM, SUM(NVL(TO_NUMBER(NULLIF(REPLACE(A.OT_TM, ':', '.'), '')), 0)) AS OT_TM, SUM(NVL(TO_NUMBER(NULLIF(REPLACE(A.NGHT_TM, ':', '.'), '')), 0)) AS NGHT_TM FROM TB_PM30M01 A INNER JOIN TB_CM06M01 U ON U.EMP_NO = A.EMP_NO AND U.SALES_AREA = 'SALESAREA60' WHERE A.CO_CD = #{coCd, jdbcType=VARCHAR} AND A.WORK_DT BETWEEN #{stDt, jdbcType=VARCHAR} AND #{edDt, jdbcType=VARCHAR}
AND (A.EMP_NO LIKE '%' || #{workerKeyword, jdbcType=VARCHAR} || '%' OR A.EMP_NM LIKE '%' || #{workerKeyword, jdbcType=VARCHAR} || '%')
AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM TB_CM06M01 D WHERE D.EMP_NO = A.EMP_NO AND SUBSTR(D.DEPT_ID, 1, 5) = SUBSTR(#{deptId, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, 1, 5))
AND (A.TRIP_APPL_NO IS NOT NULL OR A.TRIP_REPLY_NO IS NOT NULL OR A.TRIP_WORK_PLACE IS NOT NULL)
AND A.VAC_APPL_NO IS NOT NULL
GROUP BY A.EMP_NO, A.EMP_NM ORDER BY A.EMP_NM, A.EMP_NO
